Monday’s Northeast airport disruptions are a reminder that the United States’ transportation system depends on reliable, modern infrastructure.

Yet @SecDuffy is asking Congress for more money while the FAA has spent just 20% of the billions Congress already provided to modernize our air traffic control system and is well behind schedule. A recent Government Accountability Office report says the FAA still can’t clearly say how much the modernization will cost or when it will be finished.

While Duffy says we need to modernize infrastructure, he has called for eliminating the federal Mass Transit Account, which is a critical source of funding for public transportation.

You can’t claim to be fixing America’s transportation infrastructure while leaving modernization money on the table and cutting support for transit. We must invest in both.

Why did it happen? Our digital infrastructure is still running on 40-50 YEAR OLD TECHNOLOGY.

We have made incredible progress in overhauling the air traffic control system, but Congress MUST give us the money to FINISH THE JOB.
